author: realitycheckuno
quote: If this game had not received 2B in funding. If the devs hadn’t invested 13 years in to polish its graphics and map. If the hype around it hadn’t built up over these years. Then I swear, with a 100% certainty, that it would have completely flopped. The game locks you in a storyline with two characters, Jason, a bland tame person who rides the flow, and Lucia, a woman who had hidden the existence of Jason’s child from him, tossed the child away while she went on a bank robbery, and then finally came back ‘to’ Jason after she was released from jail and the child was taken into state custody. Jason then had to accept her and her story about the child without any DNA tests. Jason then had to fight to raise 2M $ with her to regain custody of the child while being locked into a dynamic that is trying to strengthen their relationship through his efforts mostly, buying her flowers and doing other domestic tasks. “Freedom to avoid the relationship” was misleading in the sense that you’re locked into bad endings then. You don’t want to play into the Romance but want a good ending? You don’t want to get involved with Lucia in any shape or form but want a good ending? No chance. You’re locked into roleplaying as a dull guy and a toxic woman. The previous GTAs had offered so much more freedom of choice and variety. I regret buying this game.
